text: {"lessons":["I tended to sell Stock B just because it was above my average cost; a gain alone is not a reason to sell, so I should weigh the investment outlook and portfolio balance.","Selling winners felt satisfying, but repeated sales reduced my exposure to Stock B and did not prevent the account from falling; I should avoid reacting to short-term price moves.","I trade rarely, so I should set a clear plan for each holding and review it periodically rather than making piecemeal decisions based mainly on gains or losses."]}
